cds.title: TCU Common Data Set 2025-2026 (PDF, Institutional Research)

cost.notes: First-year, full-time costs for 2026-27 from the Common Data Set G1: tuition $66,520, required fees $90, food and housing $18,780 (housing $12,080 + meal plan $6,700). Estimated expenses (G5, residents): books $700, transportation $1,374, other $2,278 (other costs shown = transportation + other). 34% of full-time undergraduates pay more than this tuition because tuition varies by program (G4). The CDS gives no total cost of attendance. Nonresident aid (H6, 2025-26 estimated year): institutional need-based and non-need-based aid are both available; 419 degree-seeking nonresident undergraduates received it, average $57,638 (total $24,150,348).

stats.notes: From the Common Data Set (fall 2025 entering class): 22,680 applied, 10,906 admitted, 2,754 enrolled. The residency rows (in-state / out-of-state / international / unknown) add up to the totals; the 163 applicants of unknown residency (87 admitted, 16 enrolled) are not shown separately. International: 1,277 applied, 338 admitted, 81 enrolled. The ED figures cover Early Decision only (the CDS gives no Early Action counts). TCU left the high-school GPA items (C11/C12) blank. SAT/ACT percentiles are for the 27% (752 students) and 21% (566 students) of enrollees who submitted scores; SAT/ACT is optional. TCU's testing page quotes a higher middle 50% for the fall 2026 class (SAT 1310-1460, ACT 29-33), which reflects only scores used under its Do No Harm policy. Undergraduate enrollment (11,152) and the nonresident count (447) are the 'Total Undergraduates' figures from B1/B2.
